title: Annotated competition course layout diagram
visual_facts: A rectangular course plan is drawn on the left side of a white page.
Dimension lines and numbers surround the rectangular plan.
Four English labels on the right identify zones: Mirror zone, Horizontal tunnel zone, vertical tunnel zone, and Strong wind zone.
Arrows point from these labels to areas within the plan.
Several concentric circular symbols are arranged in a zigzag down the course and joined by blue line segments.
Chinese text appears inside several outlined rectangles and along the bottom of the plan.
A Chinese figure caption is printed below the diagram.
spatial_relations: The four English zone labels form a vertical column to the right of the plan.
The marked circular positions alternate from right to left and back down the course.
The Strong wind zone label points to a lower area of the plan.
uncertainties: Most Chinese text and small dimension labels are not legible at this scale.
The diagram does not identify a specific physical venue in readable text.
